description:
• About our brand and products:

BodhiPulse is an independent jewelry label crafting hand-strung bracelets from wild-harvested natural seeds, genuine gemstones, and rare woods.

We don't do mass production. Every piece is made in small batches by artisans who care about the grain of a seed and the weight of a stone. Our bracelets are designed for the mindful modern wearer — those who value stillness, intention, and quiet strength in a loud world.


• What makes us different:

  • Wild and Handcrafted Materials: Wild-harvested seeds, natural stones, rare woods, and hand-fired coloured glaze — no synthetics, no plastic, no mass production.

  • Small Batch Only: Each bracelet is hand-strung in limited quantities. Once a batch is gone, it may never return.

  • High Perceived Value: Our pieces sit at a $200 price point, yet feel far more expensive. The natural textures, the depth of the glaze, and the handcrafted details sell themselves.

  • A Story That Resonates: This is jewelry with meaning. Nature. Time. Fire. Craftsmanship. Mindfulness. Your audience will connect with the story before they even see the price.


• How affiliates can earn:

  • Commission Rate: 26% per sale — that's approximately $52 USD per bracelet.

  • Cookie Window: 30 days. Anyone who purchases within 30 days of clicking your link earns you a commission.

  • Exclusive Discount for Your Audience: We provide you with a unique 10% OFF coupon code. Your followers get a better price, and you still earn the full 26% commission.

  • No minimum sales quota. Earn from your very first order.


• How to promote us:

You are free to promote your way. Here are proven angles that work for our brand:

  • Unboxing & First Impressions: Our packaging and product details are made for this. The natural grain of the seeds, the depth of the hand-fired glaze, the weight of each bead — show them up close.

  • Styling Content: Show how you layer our bracelet with other pieces, or how the glaze catches light as you move through your day.

  • Mindfulness & Lifestyle: Our customers buy these as anchors for their practice. Yoga, meditation, journaling — if this is your content lane, our bracelets are a natural fit.

  • Gift Guides: At $200, our bracelets sit in the "meaningful gift" sweet spot. Birthdays, anniversaries, self-care moments.

  • The Story Behind the Piece: Share where the seeds come from, how the glaze is fired, why each bead carries the weight of nature, fire, and time.

We encourage authentic content. No hard selling needed — just show the bracelet, tell the story, and share your link.

Product Samples

  • Samples are not provided for free at this time. We understand this may not suit every affiliate, and we respect that.

  • If you wish to feature our products in your content, you may purchase them at a discounted affiliate price. Please contact us for details.

  • High-quality product images and video clips are available upon request to support your content creation.

  • As we grow, we plan to offer complimentary samples to top-performing affiliates. Early joiners who perform well will be first in line.


• Other information:

  • Payments: Paid on the 5th and 20th of each month via PayPal or bank card, once your commission balance reaches the minimum payout threshold.

  • Returns: If a product is returned or refunded, the corresponding commission will be deducted.

  • Prohibited: Please do not bid on our brand name or domain in search ads, or pretend to be our official account on any platform.

  • Questions? Contact us at affiliates@bodhipulse.com — we respond within 24 hours.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to BodhiPulse! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@bodhipulse.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@bodhipulse.com for support.
